name: app-create-a-room-settings-sheet-with-member-avatars
title: Create a Room Settings Sheet
whatItIs: A close-up of a phone screen with a white sheet titled Create a room, edit and delete buttons, room name and description fields, a row of member avatars with roles, setting cards including a privacy toggle and a big blue Let's start! button.
whatItMeans: Big rounded controls and clear grouping make setup feel quick, and one blue button marks the primary action.
techniques: Rounded grey field group with plus icons
Single blue pill as the primary action
Circular icon buttons on the header

vocabulary.definition: A panel sliding up from the bottom of a screen.
A card holding one option and its control.
A full-width rounded button for the main action.
